gates.result: Immutable family versions, canonical content fingerprints, reference and mask identities, record versions, lifecycle events, and current-shadow pointers are durable and transactionally reconciled.

Draft, development_tested, shadow, invalidation, and protected rollback are implemented without an active publication path. Lifecycle authority uses only the absolute latest compatible code-owned evaluation and rechecks the current template set.
Role evidence uses only accepted OCR text, fixed text, confidence, and normalized geometry. Platform weight, expected role, file name, and upload slot cannot enter candidate selection.
Both roles are exercised at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees; weak, unknown-layout, non-ticket, and mixed-conflict observations return unknown rather than a forced binary role.
Normal, swapped, repeated, same-role, unknown, and conflicting pair contracts are explicit. Suspected swaps cannot be exchanged or passed automatically.

The protected workbench supports empty-database creation, multiple families, server-normalized reference images, anchor and region editing, three distinct time fields, reload recovery, read-only finance status, shadow confirmation, and rollback. Keyboard, focus, alert, scaling, and no-overflow checks passed.

The current generated regression reconciles all 15 results and records confusion, unknown, geometry, anchor, fallback, wrong-template, pair, conflict, and P50/P95 measurements. Field reliability is explicitly not measured.

The authoritative check passed Ruff, mypy for 129 source files, 661 backend tests with two environment-limited skips, 70 frontend tests, boundary verification, lint, typecheck, and production build. No real or legacy system was used.

No independent human-confirmed locked set of 50 unseen waybills exists. Its authoritative exclusion snapshot and persistent invalidation lifecycle are not implemented, so real accuracy and Loop 7 acceptance remain unclaimed.
